1.1 The Analytic Form of the Hahn–Banach Theorem: Extension of Linear Functionals

Let E be a vector space over R. We recall that a functional is a function defined on E, or on some subspace of E, with values in R. The main result of this section concerns the extension of a linear functional defined on a linear subspace of E by a linear functional defined on all of E.
